A newline-only inline wrapper still separates the words on either side

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "Alpha<span style=\"white-space:pre\">\n</span>13", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content as Any)
```
